name: Truthfulness
overview: Scripture reveals truthfulness as an essential attribute rooted in the character of God and exemplified in Jesus Christ, who is described as full of grace and truth. Believers are called to live in truth, reflecting God's delight in those who deal truly, while recognizing that truth leads to freedom and is foundational to worshiping God in spirit and truth. Ultimately, Jesus declares Himself as the way, the truth, and the life, emphasizing that access to the Father comes only through Him.
